name: zorko-darwha
description: Zorko Darwha static order-hub site + embedded Sanity Studio at /studio

scripts.build: npm --prefix studio install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix studio run build && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public/studio && cp index.html public/index.html && cp studio/dist/index.html public/studio/index.html && cp -r studio/dist/static public/static
